The supplied frames corroborate an operational exchange flow, including a BNB-to-MFB confirmation screen with 5.0% slippage and a subsequent transaction-submitted state. opening.argument: The creator expressly limits the presentation to technical information and repeatedly disclaims investment advice. The description says, “I have only shared technical processes, not financial advice” and warns, “Invest in crypto at your own risk.” It further states, “I don't Recommend Investing,” and that the creator has “never said they're legit” or “They're Scam.” Those are direct uncertainty and non-endorsement statements, making the content a risk-disclosed walkthrough rather than a deceptive assurance that viewers should invest or that the token is safe.
